Cc: security@acmecorp.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OneTrust import - temporary upload window and owners

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for offering to help with our OneTrust import. We're aiming to take a one-time snapshot of Redwood's Whistic/OneTrust profile and the supporting evidence bundle this month to finish our SIG assessment. A couple quick asks before we open the staging window: 

- Can Redwood provide temporary credentials or a pre-signed upload endpoint for a 48-hour window? Our ingestion tool supports S3 presigned PUTs or a service account with scoped list/read permissions.
- Please confirm the profile owners (name + email) who will be responsible for the upload so our portal can record the evidence source. We need an ownership assertion to show auditors.
- Do you have a suggested file naming convention or a mapping file for field names so our import doesn't create duplicate artifacts?

We've tentatively scheduled the import for 2026-07-20 10:00-14:00 PDT. If that doesn't work, we can move it.

Thanks,
Susan Taylor
Senior Security Manager, Acme Finance
security@acmecorp.com

(attachment: acme_import_template.csv)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Susan Taylor <susan.taylor@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OneTrust import - temporary upload window and owners

Hi Susan —

Great, we can support both options (S3 presigned PUTs or a service account). My recommended approach for minimal blast radius is:

1) We create a short-lived IAM role + temporary credentials (48h TTL) scoped to a single bucket/prefix and restricted to PutObject, ListBucket.
2) We publish a short instructions file and a YAML mapping for your importer (attached: acme_onetrust_field_mapping.yaml). That mapping flattens our internal artifact naming to your expected OneTrust fields.
3) We provide an ownership assertion in the form of an email-signed statement and add the following owners to the portal metadata so auditors can see who uploaded the bundle. Proposed owners: 
   - Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com> — Security intake lead
   - Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> — Platform security (ingest contact)

Ben will stand up the pre-signed endpoint and coordinate the exact S3 prefix during the staging window. A couple notes:
- We will rotate the temporary keys immediately after the 48h window and log the rotation in our audit stream.
- If you prefer DocuSign for an ownership attestation, we can sign and return that as well — let us know.

Proposed actions for you: confirm the owners above and the 7/20 window. Once you confirm, Ben will send the presigned URL + step-by-step.

Attachments: acme_onetrust_field_mapping.yaml, temp_creds_instructions.txt

Thanks,
Priyom
Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference
pri﻿yom.das@redwood.com
